text.p: Tropical Storm Beth has top winds near 50 mph but is strengthening in the Philippine Sea. It is expected to become a typhoon with top winds of 75 mph before landfall in the far northern portion of the Philippines over northeastern Luzon, in 24 hours. A storm surge, wind damage, flooding, and mudslides. Shipping in the region will also be at risk.

Tropical storm Lili will be an increasing risk to shipping as it nears western Cuba from the south during the next 12-24 hours. Top winds are currently 50 mph but they may reach 65 mph as the system approaches Cuba late tonight. Lili is then expected to turn east-northeast across far southern sections of Florida. Locally heavy rains will likely cause flooding in Cuba and then in Florida this period. Damage to sugarcane and Citrus is possible during this time.
